elements.description:
Spend and token limits for a live run: progress against the cap, a warning near it, a hard stop at it, and raising
the cap from the warning.

properties.name: limits
properties.description: The limits – the first one is the big meter. Raises apply unless a tc-limits-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: status
properties.description: The run: "running", "paused" or "done" – always set by the app

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: task
properties.description: What runs, a quiet line under the heading

properties.name: warnAt
properties.description: Share of a cap from which the card warns (0–1)

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Currency of "currency" limits, an ISO 4217 code

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-limits-change
events.description: A cap was raised (detail: { limits: BudgetLimit[], id: string, cap: number, previous: number }); cancelable

events.name: tc-cap-reach
events.description: A limit reached its cap – halt the run (detail: { id: string, limit: BudgetLimit })

props.name: limits
props.description:
The limits – the first one is the big meter. Controlled when defined (a live run passes its numbers in): pair
with onLimitsChange or onRaise and pass the raised cap back. Otherwise the component keeps them, starting from
`defaultLimits`

props.name: onLimitsChange
props.description: Every raise, with all the limits after it

props.name: onRaise
props.type: (id: string, cap: number, previous: number) => void
props.description: A cap raised from the warning or the stop: the limit's id, its new cap and the one before

props.name: onCapReach
props.description: A limit reached its cap – halt the run

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

changelog: `tc-budget-guard` – spend and token caps for a live run: a big meter and thin ones, the pace to the cap, a warning with Raise to buttons at `warnAt`, and a hard stop with an alert. `tc-limits-change` (cancelable), `tc-cap-reach` once per cap, `tc-stop`.
